long_biography.plain_text:
Accounting and finance studies at ICHEC in Brussels preceded Victor Restis's move into maritime management. The inherited company initially specialised in refrigerated cargo, giving him an established commercial base rather than an independent start. His later strategy broadened both vessel types and the way the business participated in freight markets.

The scale change was clearest in 2004. First Financial Corporation bought MISC's 32-ship bulker fleet, taking the Restis organisation into categories it had previously lacked. Newbuildings, South African Marine Corporation and a mix of owned and chartered capacity deepened that shift. Subsequent activity added modern tanker and commercial-fleet operations. Enterprises Shipping & Trading remains the central management business connecting those activities.
